The Assistant failed to ask for clarification about the endpoint year for the 24% figure on Girls Who Code’s own materials (where “today” is unspecified) and did not request WebSurfer to fully verify the NCWIT image text or reconcile source differences. This matches FM-2.2: the agent proceeded on ambiguous inputs without seeking clarification, made unfounded assumptions, and did not verify relevance/accuracy, leading to an incorrect 16-year answer instead of the ground truth.
